trailhead.label: Klammeben, top station of the Hirzer cable car, the board’s start

cautions: Cattle graze the alpine pastures in summer: keep your dog on a short lead, give cows a wide berth and let go of the lead if cattle charge.
At about 2,000–2,130 m the weather turns fast: check the forecast and turn back in a storm.
Busy with walkers on the E5 in summer: keep your dog close.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Hirzer alms loop from Klammeben: Anello delle malghe dell’Hirzer da Klammeben
textIt.Klammeben, top station of the Hirzer cab: Klammeben, stazione a monte della funivia Hirzer, la partenza indicata dalla scheda ufficiale
textIt.Cattle graze the alpine pastures in summ: D'estate il bestiame pascola sui pascoli alpini: tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto, stai ben lontano dalle mucche e molla il guinzaglio se il bestiame carica.
textIt.At about 2,000–2,130 m the weather turns: A circa 2.000–2.130 m il tempo cambia in fretta: controlla le previsioni e torna indietro in caso di temporale.
textIt.Busy with walkers on the E5 in summer: k: D'estate molti escursionisti sull'E5: tieni il cane vicino.
